regions.summary: Narrow Jinsha-side valleys of northeast Yunnan: Yanjin, Daguan, Suijiang, Shuifu, plus a bit of Yibin county in Sichuan.

candidates.name: Yanjin
candidates.meaning: "Salt ford": named for salt wells and a ferry crossing.
candidates.fit: Yanjin county is 33% of the region's people and nearly all of it is inside; seat of the Nanguang commandery for 247 years.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; the 'narrowest county town' and cliff coffins.
candidates.source_note: 因曾拥有盐井产盐并设渡口渡汛而得名

candidates.name: Hengjiang
candidates.meaning: "Cross river": the Guan River, a right-bank tributary of the Jinsha.
candidates.fit: Flows down the valleys of this region to join the Jinsha at Shuifu, though its upper course is in the Ludian/Zhaoyang regions.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 649 hits with 云南, top ones about this river.
candidates.source_note: 亦称关河……在云南省水富县云富镇汇入金沙江

candidates.name: Daguan
candidates.meaning: "Great pass": many fortified passes and stockades in rugged terrain.
candidates.fit: Daguan county is 23% of the region; Yanjin is larger and the better known of the two.
candidates.source_note: 以全县地势险要、关口众多……而得名

regions.notes: Suijiang (绥江, 13% of people) not offered: 绥 means to pacify.

regions.summary: Eastern Zhaotong: Yiliang, Weixin and a part of Zhenxiong, around Zhaxi and Jiaokui.

candidates.name: Yiliang
candidates.meaning: From the old Yiniang tribal area (易娘部, Yiliang zhou 益良州); modern characters read 'Yi people, good'.
candidates.fit: Yiliang county is 39% of the region's people; its seat Jiaokui (Xiezhou, Dong'an) is in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current county, known for the 2012 earthquake.
candidates.source_note: 于易娘部置益良州（治今彝良县）

candidates.name: Zhaxi
candidates.meaning: Old name of Weixin town; the Zhaxi Conference of 1935 was held here.
candidates.fit: Zhaxi town is the region's largest town (13%) and Weixin county is 35% of it.
candidates.recognisability: Famous through the Zhaxi Conference; a town of 144k in the city list.

regions.notes: Weixin is rejected only because Zhaxi is better known and the Weixin name is 20th century; Yiliang and Zhaxi are both good.

regions.summary: Zhenxiong county (99%), the Chishui headwaters and old Mangbu seat.

candidates.name: Mangbu
candidates.meaning: Name of the Yi chieftaincy (Mangbu 茫部/茫布部) that ruled this area; the name is a transcription.
candidates.fit: Mangbu route/prefecture was seated at today's Mangbu town in this region for 268 years; it also covered Yiliang and Weixin.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki articles for the route and prefecture, 230 hits with 云南, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 治所在今云南省镇雄县北芒部；辖境相当今云南省镇雄、彝良、威信等县

candidates.name: Zhenxiong
candidates.meaning: "Subdue the strong": Ming renaming of Mangbu prefecture after the 1526 gaitu guiliu.
candidates.fit: Zhenxiong county is 99% of the region's people; the prefecture seat is here.
candidates.source_note: 嘉靖五年（1526年）改土归流，芒部府改名镇雄军民府

regions.notes: Zhenxiong is the plain county name but the meaning is a conquest name for a largely Yi area, so Mangbu is ranked first; Anita's call.

regions.summary: Southwest Zhaotong: Ludian, Qiaojia and Yongshan on the Jinsha, including Xiluodu.

candidates.name: Ludian
candidates.meaning: Origin of the name not confirmed in the sources read.
candidates.fit: Ludian county is 36% of the region's people and the region holds all of it.
candidates.recognisability: Current county, known for the 2014 earthquake.
candidates.source_note: 县人民政府驻文屏街道

candidates.name: Niulan
candidates.meaning: "Ox pen": a stone shaped like an ox lies in the river near its mouth.
candidates.fit: The Niulan River runs along the southwest edge toward the Jinsha, mostly past Ludian and Qiaojia rather than through the middle.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; the Han-period Tanglang River.
candidates.source_note: 因河口附近有一天然巨石形状似牛，横卧江心，故得名

regions.notes: Qiaojia (26%) and Yongshan (26%) are not offered because the region holds only part of each. Huize to the south is already named.

regions.summary: Zhaotong city (Zhaoyang district) on the Wumeng-area plateau, with a slice of Weining county in Guizhou.

candidates.name: Zhaotong
candidates.meaning: "Bright and open": the 1731 renaming of Wumeng prefecture, roughly 'make the way clear'.
candidates.fit: Holds the city centre; Zhaoyang district is 87% of the region's people; the seat of the prefecture of that name.
candidates.source_note: 昭通府 (1731-1911) 今云南省昭通市治

candidates.name: Wumeng
candidates.meaning: Name of the old Wumeng tribal territory, a transcription; also the Wumeng mountains.
candidates.fit: Wumeng route and prefecture were seated here for 450 years in all.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki articles for the route, prefecture and mountains, 324 hits with 云南.
candidates.source_note: 治所在今云南省昭通市

candidates.name: Shushi
candidates.meaning: Han county of the Shushi commandery, a transcription; usually read Zhuti in Chinese, Shushi in Wikipedia.
candidates.fit: County seat 109 BC to AD 764 here; the commandery lay around Zhaotong.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for the commandery, 337 hits with 云南.

regions.notes: Zhaotong's urban population (Zhaoyang district) is under 1M, so the city rule does not force it. The name 昭通 is a Qing gaitu guiliu renaming but means opening the way, not pacifying the frontier, so I kept it first; Wumeng is the alternative if Anita prefers the older name.
